generation.scope: In the marked one-sided symmetric finite branch with symmetric nets spanning a four-space, the determinant of the prescribed commutator is the product of the linear commutator of their common plane and the conic of their trace normal. It vanishes identically exactly when the common plane commutes. For three independent target brackets and either four- or five-dimensional sum, every irreducible realizing triple is reconstructed on sixteen cyclic charts from one traceless matrix satisfying two linear and two quadratic trace equations and linear consistency conditions.

open_mathematics: Analyze the three-bracket reconstruction on the line of singular commutators, especially the common commuting plane and rank drops of the conic. Use finite-edge and growth obstructions to identify or exclude positive-dimensional solution charts. Continue the nonreduced finite-graph branch at seventeen sites.
